rules: No text correction in semantic review stage.

WEIRD_PHRASE/BROKEN_TEXT require audio/ASR verification or later text-fix review.
DROP_FRAGMENT/PARALINGUISTIC are excluded from the clean narration candidate pool.
review_note: Packs 0003-0012 use conservative direct GitHub review with shared surface-error rules learned from the same source, plus lossless splitting and risk-only phonetic/repetition flags. No text is corrected in this stage.
